hostLoad: Shared host: GPU jobs of cooperating agents are serialized by a lock, other host work is not; timings are paired and interleaved observations, not benchmark records
stopTokenNote: Long runs register stop id 151935 (an unused padding row of the 151936-row head) so decoding is not cut short by EOS
tolerance: per forced row: cosine >= 0.995 against float32 reference; argmax equal unless a near-tie (reference top-1 minus top-2 probability < 0.1 and native token within reference top-5); greedy continuation identical to the reference's, or first diverging at a reference near-tie by the same rule (judged on the reference's teacher-forced row at that index, where both prefixes are equal)
